scope.target_boundary: Local request failure within the declared observation window; no organizational why.

causal_conditions.statement: 在30请求同时到达、资源持有参数20ms、获取期限100ms的本地实验中，池容量从40缩为4。

causal_edges.mechanism: 在该受控本地模型的相同突发负载下，容量40→4→40仅中间条件出现获取超时；这不确认旧版平稳流量场景，也不证明任何数据库故障。

must_preserve_unknown: Original authored incident, SQL behavior, real external service load and organizational why are not established.
forbidden_assertions: A successful health probe proves every business route healthy.
Missing/unavailable source proves the remote process crashed.
Temporal correlation alone proves a unique root cause.

fixed_controls.statement: 在本地实验中，相同30请求同时到达的突发负载下，池容量40→4→40时仅容量4的试次出现资源获取超时。
该故障观测时间窗内，远端数据库进程发生崩溃。

provenance.reference_basis: Passed local-program measurements with raw execution and source snapshots; causal interpretation remains pending human review.
provenance.required_next_step: Review the measured evidence, information boundary and causal interpretation; machine execution is not human gold.
notes: Measured new local-program scenario; not a reproduction of the original authored v1 incident.

limitations: A local Python semaphore pool and measured sleep model resource occupancy; no real database or production service is exercised.
30 requests per one-second offered-load window is insufficient to characterize burstiness. Smooth load at 30/s and 20ms has mean occupancy about 0.6, below capacity4.
The burst arm releases all30 requests together and uses an explicit100ms acquisition timeout. These conditions were absent from rca_v1 and are new experimental parameters.
This evidence does not validate or rewrite the authored rca_v1 replay row, original timestamps, in_use/waiter counts, or SQL claims.
OS scheduling affects measured timing. Checks retain failures rather than rewriting observations or silently retrying.
